mcp__recraft__get_user
selected_signatures.description:
Get information about the current user: ID, email, name, and the accounts available to them.
Lists the personal account and every workspace the user is a member of, each with its workspace_id, name, role, plan and the credits available there, and marks which account is active; credits_balance is the balance of the active account.
Call this to find a workspace's id before select_workspace, or when the user asks which account is active or how many credits they have. The select_workspace tool changes the active account.


Recraft accounts: every user has a personal account and may be a member of team workspaces. Exactly one account is active for this MCP connection at a time. The personal account is active unless the user selected a workspace with select_workspace; that choice holds across sessions and conversations until the user changes it or selects "personal". get_user lists the personal account and every workspace the user is a member of, with its workspace_id, role, plan and available credits, and marks the active one. When the user names a team, brand, client or workspace, call get_user to find it and confirm with the user before calling select_workspace; never select a workspace on your own.
Billing: a call in the personal account is charged to the personal balance. A call in a workspace is charged to the user's seat subscription in that workspace first, then to the workspace credit account, never to the personal balance; its results are stored in the workspace where teammates see them, and the workspace's shared styles are available. When the active account has no credits for a call, the call fails and nothing is charged anywhere; the error names the active account and, if another of the user's accounts has more credits, says which one (JFYI); a workspace is topped up by a billing admin at https://www.recraft.ai/profile/workspace. The Design Agent (call_agent) always runs in the personal account.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__recraft__get_user(args: { [key: string]: unknown; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

notes: This live connection supersedes the previous unauthenticated 403 discovery limitation. No credentials or account identifiers stored.
